name: support_bot
prompt_template:
You are a helpful customer support assistant. Please carefully and politely answer the customer's question in order to resolve their issue. Kindly be concise.

Question: {input}

eval_cases.input: How do I reset my password?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Go to Settings > Security and click Reset Password. You'll get an email with a reset link.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Go to Settings, click Reset Password. Check your email for the reset link.

eval_cases.input: How can I cancel my subscription?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Open your Account page, go to Billing, and click Cancel Subscription.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Go to Account > Billing and click Cancel Subscription.

eval_cases.input: Can I change the email address on my account?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Yes, go to Account Settings, update your email, and verify the new address.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Yes, in Account Settings update your email and verify it.

eval_cases.input: Where can I download my past invoices?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Your invoices are under Billing > Invoices, where you can download each one as a PDF.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Under Billing > Invoices you can download each invoice.

eval_cases.input: How do I upgrade to the Pro plan?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Go to Billing, select Plans, and choose the Pro plan to upgrade.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Go to Billing > Plans and choose Pro to upgrade.

eval_cases.input: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Go to Security Settings and enable two-factor authentication with the toggle.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: In Security Settings, enable two-factor authentication.

eval_cases.input: Can I export all my data?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Yes, go to Settings > Data and click Export All Data to download an archive.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: Yes, in Settings > Data click Export All Data.

eval_cases.input: How do I permanently delete my account?
eval_cases.mock_baseline: Go to Account Settings, scroll to Danger Zone, and click Delete Account permanently.
eval_cases.mock_candidate: In Account Settings, Danger Zone, click Delete Account permanently.
